newsitem.title: CANADA: Oxford to borrow $100 mln for acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Oxford to borrow $100 mln for acquisition.

text.p: Oxford Properties Group Inc said on Friday it will borrow C$100 million from Burcon International Developments Ltd to complete its purchase of Canadian Pacific's real estate unit.
Oxford said Burcon, its largest shareholder, agreed to lend the money on market terms and conditions.
Oxford also said it anticipated going to capital markets in due course to refinance the Burcon loan.

"The acquisition of a 50 percent interest in Marathon will add considerably to Oxford's assets and business and will have a significant impact on our earnings, earnings per share and future growth," said Oxford chief executive Jon Love in a statement.
